age_deidentified_rule: anchor_age=91 -> numeric proxy90, NOT exact age; other estimated ages clipped at90
duplicate_rule: remove exact repeated item/time/specimen/value/unit, then collapse conflicting same item/time/specimen values by median
bp_rule: matched same-time arterial SBP/MAP pair first, otherwise matched noninvasive pair; 0<MAP<=SBP and if DBP present 0<DBP<=MAP; no valid pair -> both missing
respiratory_rule: 220210 preferred; 224690 used only if preferred source absent
outlier_rule: retain within broad technical ranges; review extreme observations using adjacent source values; stricter-screened sensitivity is separate
all_physiology_missing_rule: retain in frozen cohort but exclude from primary phenotype-fitting population; all-patient inclusion sensitivity required
imputation_rule: median and gender mode fitted only among eligible training rows; apply frozen values to other partitions
